stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 log [-p] [--oneline] [--log-size] [--skip=<n>] [--max-count=<n>]
                 [--author=<pattern>] [--committer=<pattern>]
                 [--grep=<pattern>] [--merges] [--no-merges] [--date-order]
                 [--topo-order] [--reverse] [<revisions>...] [--] [<paths>...]

Show commit logs.

Options:
    -p, --patch
        generate patch
    --oneline
        show commits on one line
    --log-size
        show log message size
    --skip=<n>
        skip n commits
    --max-count=<n>
        limit to n commits
    --author=<pattern>
        filter by author
    --committer=<pattern>
        filter by committer
    --grep=<pattern>
        filter by commit message
    --merges
        show only merge commits
    --no-merges
        show only non-merge commits
    --date-order
        sort by date
    --topo-order
        sort topologically
    --reverse
        reverse order
    <revisions>...
        starting revisions
    <paths>...
        limit to specific paths
